description: This file defines the Feed controller class within the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installation, uninstallation, and validation of feed extensions in the admin interface.

classes.name: Feed
classes.description: Controller class for managing feed extensions in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the list of available feed extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of feed extensions, checking installed extensions and loading language strings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to modify feed extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a feed extension, including permission management, autoload registration, and invoking potential install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a feed extension, including permission check and invoking uninstall scripts.
